g.title: note0
g.text: actedThisTurn is private and is set only
inside perform(), which is final. No subclass
can bypass 'at most one task per turn', and
a refused task never uses up the turn.

g.title: note1
g.text: satisfaction, status and order are private.
They change only through seat(), placeOrder(),
each guarded by a whyNot...() check.

g.title: note2
g.text: a Customer reference; there are no type checks.

g.title: note3
g.text: in its constructor; they do not exist outside it.
